description: Generates and checks the named route inventory against route_contract.dart identities and go_router.dart runtime wiring, including semantic nested paths, normalized builder/pageBuilder presentation targets, locally declared block- and arrow-bodied route helpers, direct MaterialPageRoute sites, and a redirect-only exception for retired raw legacy paths. Imported or prebuilt route collections, constructor typedefs, and unsupported full-screen PageRoute forms fail closed through the resolved composition gate.
